name: BusinessGov
tagline: Concept app for entrepreneurs filing appeals with Uzbekistan's Business Ombudsman
role: App prototype by the Softwhere team

scenes.title: Sign-in built for entrepreneurs
scenes.body: INN and phone with a 4-digit confirmation code, or Mobile ID by key or by password.

scenes.title: Two quick questions before the appeal
scenes.body: Applicants pick who they are writing as (company, investor or individual), then their business sector.

scenes.title: Applicant details in one form
scenes.body: Birth date, region, district, mahalla, employment and an optional email, then on to the appeal.

scenes.title: Write the appeal, attach files, send
scenes.body: Subject, category and appeal text, plus a file upload area and a send button.
